description: Configurable physical relay to zone mapping for Smart Lab Automation

1.label: Real Light 1 (Relay 1)

2.label: Real Light 2 (Relay 2)

status_led.description: Optional ESP32 onboard status LED only; NOT an appliance or light substitute

pzem.description: Single PZEM-004T physical CT sensor connected to Light 1 in Zone Z2
